event.description: Tie the eleventh-closest positional scalar groups
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 2,108 parameters at 99.050000%, a +0.050000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 14 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0071, the tenth positional union at 2,108 parameters and 99.05%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0034. The closest current groups have representatives 500 and 273, values 0.0105745886 and 0.0105778286, differing by 3.240e-6. Hypothesis: sharing their mean cumulatively preserves qualification and yields 2,107 parameters. This is more informative than any other untested union because it is the recomputed minimum-distortion merge after ten accepted positional reductions.
